_readme: Shared source of truth for the differential harness. Both newt/tools/capture_mujoco.py and tests/differential.rs iterate this list. Fields: name (string), mjcf (path relative to this file), n_steps (total steps to run), stride (record every Nth step; sample 0 = initial state), init_qvel (optional MuJoCo-layout qvel override applied before stepping), targets (optional per-step actuator control array), horizon_note (free text for the scorecard).

scenarios.name: ballistic
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s free flight, no contacts.

scenarios.name: tumble
scenarios.horizon_note: 4.0 s torque-free rotation, intermediate-axis instability.

scenarios.name: double_pendulum
scenarios.horizon_note: 0.4 s short horizon; long-run divergence is chaotic and expected.

scenarios.name: double_pendulum_energy
scenarios.horizon_note: 5.0 s long-horizon total-energy drift. Component-wise qpos check is skipped (chaotic); the assertion is that newt's RK4 drift stays small AND is similar in magnitude to MuJoCo's.

scenarios.name: servo_arm
scenarios.horizon_note: 4.0 s reaching a fixed pose from rest.

scenarios.name: sphere_drop
scenarios.horizon_note: 3.0 s drop-and-settle; steady-state penetration is the scorecard signal.

scenarios.name: sphere_drop_stiff
scenarios.horizon_note: 3.0 s drop-and-settle at tc=0.010 (stiffer contact); solref-sweep companion to sphere_drop.

scenarios.name: sphere_drop_soft
scenarios.horizon_note: 3.0 s drop-and-settle at tc=0.050 (softer contact); solref-sweep companion to sphere_drop.

scenarios.name: box_stack
scenarios.horizon_note: 4.0 s multi-contact settle; loosest tolerances of the suite.

scenarios.name: floating_base
scenarios.horizon_note: 1.0 s zero-gravity free-root + hinge to exercise every slot of the free-root remap (quat slot order, linear-vs-angular slot order, body-vs-world linear frame).

scenarios.name: tree_chain_contact
scenarios.horizon_note: 1.0 s falling two-link free-root chain with ground contact; matched Newton/Euler capture checks tree link Jacobians and the first contact transition.

scenarios.name: joint_limit_swing
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s swing driving the hinge past the ±0.6 rad range limit repeatedly.

scenarios.name: velocity_cartpole
scenarios.horizon_note: 4.0 s velocity-actuator holding a target cart rate while the pole swings under Coriolis coupling. Validates v2 tier-2 <velocity> semantics (gain=fixed(kv), bias=affine(0,0,-kv)).

scenarios.name: filtered_motor_pendulum
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s filtered-motor step response (ctrl=0.7 through a tau=0.05 activation filter). Validates v2 tier-2 activation dynamics (dyntype=filter). Bounded divergence expected because newt uses forward Euler on activation vs MuJoCo's RK4.

scenarios.name: tendon_coupled
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s two-pendulum fixed-tendon coupling under gravity. Validates v2 tier-3 fixed-tendon length + Jacobian + passive-spring Jᵀ distribution.

scenarios.name: tendon_wrap
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s hanging mass on a spatial tendon wrapping a sphere. Validates v2 tier-3 site position Jacobian + sphere-wrap tangent-arc geometry + envelope-theorem force distribution.

scenarios.name: tendon_cylinder_lift
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s matched-Euler cylinder-wrapped tendon actuator lifting a slide mass. Validates 2D circle side selection, sidesite choice, axial lift, and the actuator Jacobian.

scenarios.name: tendon_pulley_2to1
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s matched-Euler 2:1 pulley branch actuator. Validates branch length and Jacobian divisor scaling against MuJoCo.

scenarios.name: tendon_mixed_wrap
scenarios.horizon_note: 2.0 s matched-Euler passive tendon through sphere and cylinder wraps. Validates mixed-chain length and envelope-theorem forces.

scenarios.name: mocap_rangefinder
scenarios.horizon_note: 0.5 s direct rangefinder, velocimeter, and magnetometer comparison on a mocap body.

scenarios.name: hfield_sphere_ramp
scenarios.horizon_note: 1.0 s sphere rolling down an uneven hfield ramp; matched Euler PGS.

scenarios.name: hfield_box_terrain
scenarios.horizon_note: 1.0 s tilted box settling on uneven hfield terrain; matched Euler PGS.

scenarios.name: hfield_capsule_waves
scenarios.horizon_note: 1.0 s tilted capsule crossing a wavy hfield; matched Euler PGS.
